{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794673425243,"sessionID":"ses_e2527c85effeTdcy2xLqZWsu4M","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"4HduNYPZ7WatsQYc","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\n# Current owned&powered before new orders:\n# m11..19: us 7.14 + eu 4.00 + ap 14.85 = 25.99\n# m20..23: us 0 + eu 0 + ap 14.85 = 14.85 (unless we renew us/eu power or move GPUs!)\n# ap 3k reserve ends after m12 (active m11..12)\n\n# Suppose in Month 11 we reserve MAX 12m cloud (m12..23, ZERO tail months!):\n# reserve 4 12 us ($1.074M/kH-mo), reserve 3 12 eu ($1.181M/kH-mo), reserve 3 12 ap ($1.020M/kH-mo)\n# Total = +10 kH/mo for m12..23! (monthly cost = 4*1.074 + 3*1.181 + 3*1.020 = 10.90M/mo)\n# Let's check Run 2 (m11..15) if we also order 8k Gen N (4k ships m14 -> +8 kH, 4k ships m15 -> +16 kH):\ninf_est = [13.75 * (1.07**(m-10)) for m in range(11, 16)]\ncap_r2 = [28.99, 25.99+3+10, 25.99+10, 25.99+10+8, 25.99+10+16]\nprint('Run2 m11..15 inf est:', [round(x,1) for x in inf_est], 'sum=', round(sum(inf_est),1))\nprint('Run2 m11..15 cap:', [round(x,1) for x in cap_r2], 'sum=', round(sum(cap_r2),1))\nprint('Run2 m11..15 train est:', round(sum(cap_r2)-sum(inf_est),1), 'vs needed 91.1!')\n\n# Check Run 3 (m16..23) with 10 kH reserves (m16..23) + 12k Gen N in ap (24 kH) + 5k Gen N in us (10 kH) = 34 kH Gen N!\n# Owned H powered: m16..19 = 25.99, m20..23 = 14.85 (ap only!)\n# Wait: in m16..23, total cap = [25.99+10+34]*4 + [14.85+10+34]*4 = 69.99*4 + 58.85*4 = 515.4 kH-mo!\ninf_r3 = [13.75 * (1.07**(m-10)) for m in range(16, 24)]\nprint('Run3 m16..23 inf est (from m10=13.75):', [round(x,1) for x in inf_r3], 'sum=', round(sum(inf_r3),1), '+320 =', round(sum(inf_r3)+320,1))\n# Wait: m10=13.75 might be noisy above trend 11.80; on trend 6*1.07^m, m16..23 sum is 181.7!\n# If trend is 181.7 + 320 = 501.7, and 515.4 > 501.7, check by site!\nfor m in [15, 19, 23]:\n    d = 6.0 * (1.07**m)\n    print(f'm{m} trend inf: tot={d:.1f} (us={0.5*d:.1f}, eu={0.3*d:.1f}, ap={0.2*d:.1f})')\n\""},"output":"Run2 m11..15 inf est: [14.7, 15.7, 16.8, 18.0, 19.3] sum= 84.6\nRun2 m11..15 cap: [29.0, 39.0, 36.0, 44.0, 52.0] sum= 199.9\nRun2 m11..15 train est: 115.3 vs needed 91.1!\nRun3 m16..23 inf est (from m10=13.75): [20.6, 22.1, 23.6, 25.3, 27.0, 28.9, 31.0, 33.1] sum= 211.7 +320 = 531.7\nm15 trend inf: tot=16.6 (us=8.3, eu=5.0, ap=3.3)\nm19 trend inf: tot=21.7 (us=10.8, eu=6.5, ap=4.3)\nm23 trend inf: tot=28.4 (us=14.2, eu=8.5, ap=5.7)\n","metadata":{"output":"Run2 m11..15 inf est: [14.7, 15.7, 16.8, 18.0, 19.3] sum= 84.6\nRun2 m11..15 cap: [29.0, 39.0, 36.0, 44.0, 52.0] sum= 199.9\nRun2 m11..15 train est: 115.3 vs needed 91.1!\nRun3 m16..23 inf est (from m10=13.75): [20.6, 22.1, 23.6, 25.3, 27.0, 28.9, 31.0, 33.1] sum= 211.7 +320 = 531.7\nm15 trend inf: tot=16.6 (us=8.3, eu=5.0, ap=3.3)\nm19 trend inf: tot=21.7 (us=10.8, eu=6.5, ap=4.3)\nm23 trend inf: tot=28.4 (us=14.2, eu=8.5, ap=5.7)\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c \"\n# Current owned&powered before new orders:\n# m11..19: us 7.14 + eu 4.00 + ap 14.85 = 25.99\n# m20..23: us 0 + eu 0 + ap 14.85 = 14.85 (unless we renew us/eu power or move GPUs!)\n# ap 3k reserve ends after m12 (active m11..12)\n\n# Suppose in Month 11 we reserve MAX 12m cloud (m12..23, ZERO tail months!):\n# reserve 4 12 us ($1.074M/kH-mo), reserve 3 12 eu ($1.181M/kH-mo), reserve 3 12 ap ($1.020M/kH-mo)\n# Total = +10 kH/mo for m12..23! (monthly cost = 4*1.074 + 3*1.181 + 3*1.020 = 10.90M/mo)\n# Let's check Run 2 (m11..15) if we also order 8k Gen N (4k ships m14 -> +8 kH, 4k ships m15 -> +16 kH):\ninf_est = [13.75 * (1.07**(m-10)) for m in range(11, 16)]\ncap_r2 = [28.99, 25.99+3+10, 25.99+10, 25.99+10+8, 25.99+10+16]\nprint('Run2 m11..15 inf est:', [round(x,1) for x in inf_est], 'sum=', round(sum(inf_est),1))\nprint('Run2 m11..15 cap:', [round(x,1) for x in cap_r2], 'sum=', round(sum(cap_r2),1))\nprint('Run2 m11..15 train est:', round(sum(cap_r2)-sum(inf_est),1), 'vs needed 91.1!')\n\n# Check Run 3 (m16..23) with 10 kH reserves (m16..23) + 12k Gen N in ap (24 kH) + 5k Gen N in us (10 kH) = 34 kH Gen N!\n# Owned H powered: m16..19 = 25.99, m20..23 = 14.85 (ap only!)\n# Wait: in m16..23, total cap = [25.99+10+34]*4 + [14.85+10+34]*4 = 69.99*4 + 58.85*4 = 515.4 kH-mo!\ninf_r3 = [13.75 * (1.07**(m-10)) for m in range(16, 24)]\nprint('Run3 m16..23 inf est (from m10=13.75):', [round(x,1) for x in inf_r3], 'sum=', round(sum(inf_r3),1), '+320 =', round(sum(inf_r3)+320,1))\n# Wait: m10=13.75 might be noisy above trend 11.80; on trend 6*1.07^m, m16..23 sum is 181.7!\n# If trend is 181.7 + 320 = 501.7, and 515.4 > 501.7, check by site!\nfor m in [15, 19, 23]:\n    d = 6.0 * (1.07**m)\n    print(f'm{m} trend inf: tot={d:.1f} (us={0.5*d:.1f}, eu={0.3*d:.1f}, ap={0.2*d:.1f})')\n\"","time":{"start":1794673425203,"end":1794673425238}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dadf3b2c001VWyGS58UC3br9c","sessionID":"ses_e2527c85effeTdcy2xLqZWsu4M","messageID":"msg_1dadf10830010m5xo2wlSAfV0I"}}
